title: Pork Sausage Rolls
subtitle: Flaky rough-puff pastry around a seasoned pork filling
excerpt: Herby pork mince wrapped in a buttery rough-puff pastry and baked until golden. These are a British party and picnic staple.
sourceNotes: Sausage rolls have been a British baked good since at least the 19th century. They remain one of the most popular items at bakeries and gatherings across the country.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze unbaked on a lined tray, then transfer to freezer bags. Bake from frozen at 200C for 30 minutes.
recipe.batchNotes: Doubles well. Make the pastry in two batches.

content.text: Cold butter and a light hand with the pastry are the two keys here. Do not overwork the dough.

items.prepNote: cold, grated or cut into small cubes

content.text: Preheat your oven to 200C. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
Put the flour in a bowl with a pinch of salt. Add the cold butter.
Rub the butter in lightly. Leave some pea-sized lumps for flakiness.
Add 4 to 5 tablespoons of cold water. Bring together into a rough dough. Do not overwork it.
Mix the pork mince with the sage, fennel seeds and mustard. Season well with salt and pepper.
Roll the pastry on a floured surface into a large rectangle, about 3mm thick.
Cut the pastry into two long strips.
Shape the pork filling into two long logs and lay one down each strip.
Brush one edge of each strip with egg wash. Roll the pastry over the filling and press the seam firmly.
Cut each log into 6 equal pieces. Place seam-side down on the tray.
Brush with egg wash. Score the top of each roll with a knife.
Bake for 25 minutes until deep golden and the filling is cooked through.

items.cause: Butter was overworked into the flour.
items.fix: Leave visible lumps of butter when rubbing in next time.

items.symptom: Filling is pink inside after 25 minutes.
items.cause: Rolls were too thick or oven not hot enough.
items.fix: Use a probe thermometer; core should reach 75C.

items.cause: Seam was not pressed firmly enough.
items.fix: Press seam edges firmly and place seam-side down.
